name: @nextwebwg/html
description: Polyfill and component bridge for the HTML Next proposals.

scripts.check:generated: tsx scripts/generate-dom-properties.ts --check && tsx scripts/generate-looma-scaffolds.ts --check && tsx scripts/check-example-generated.ts
scripts.test:browser: HTMLNEXT_BROWSER_TEST=1 node --import tsx --test test/browser-loader.test.ts test/conformance.test.ts test/forms.test.ts test/runtime.test.ts test/source-adapters.test.ts test/validity.test.ts
scripts.test:looma: HTMLNEXT_LOOMA_TEST=1 node --import tsx --test test/migrate-stencil.test.ts test/looma-inventory.test.ts test/looma-css.test.ts test/looma-components.test.ts test/looma-layout.test.ts test/looma-package.test.ts test/package.test.ts test/consumer-knit.test.ts test/consumer-loadops.test.ts
scripts.test:consumer: npm run build && HTMLNEXT_CONSUMER_TEST=1 node --import tsx --test test/consumer-package.test.ts
